results.content: Joanne Hsu, director of the University of Michigan Surveys of Consumers, said sentiment fell across the political spectrum, with Republicans recording the steepest month-to-month drop. "Sentiment among Republicans is now 19% below readings just prior to the Iran conflict and the lowest since the 2024 election," Hsu said in a statement. Notably large declines were also recorded among older consumers, lower-income consumers, and those without a college degree — groups Hsu described as [...] The decline was broad-based.
